construction.dockerfile:
FROM ai-harness:mod01-typescript-gc-e2e-r1 AS test-runner
WORKDIR /app
# Clear inherited generated outputs/cache only in this new build, not any retained resource.
RUN node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs';import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';const cache='/app/packages/core/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo';if(!fs.statSync(cache).isFile())throw new Error('Expected inherited Core incremental file');console.log('INVALIDATE_INHERITED_CORE_CACHE '+createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(cache)).digest('hex'));fs.rmSync(cache);for(const p of ['core','cli','server','web'])fs.rmSync('/app/packages/'+p+'/dist',{recursive:true,force:true});"
COPY . .

# Process tests consume emitted Core/CLI/Server and the real Web bundle.
# Build dependencies first; never rely on a local dist surviving COPY.
RUN npm run build --workspace @ai-harness/core \
    && npm run build --workspace @ai-harness/cli \
    && npm run build --workspace @ai-harness/server \
    && npm run build --workspace @ai-harness/web
RUN node --test .docker/test-build.test.mjs

# Run against COPY's filtered context, not a later source overlay. Fail the image
# build if the E2E entry point, declarations or owning configurations are missing.
RUN node --test .docker/e2e-suites.test.mjs


ENV PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/usr
ENV PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_VALIDATE_HOST_REQUIREMENTS=true
ENV CI=true

CMD ["npm", "test"]
